name: terrahash-autopilot
description: Host connector skills and MCP config for TerraHash Autopilot and BTC Insights (read-only; placeholders only).

AUTOPILOT_MCP_URL.title: Autopilot MCP URL
AUTOPILOT_MCP_URL.description: HTTP MCP base URL for Autopilot (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:18100/mcp). No public FQDN is claimed by this plugin.

BTC_INSIGHTS_MCP_URL.title: BTC Insights MCP URL
BTC_INSIGHTS_MCP_URL.description: HTTP MCP base URL for BTC Insights. Operators supply an approved endpoint; this plugin ships placeholders only.
